name: Not Being Offended
overview: Scripture teaches that those who love God's law enjoy great peace and are not easily offended, experiencing no stumbling blocks in their faith. Wisdom calls for discretion and patience, encouraging believers to defer anger and overlook transgressions as a mark of glory. The psalmist models prayerful response even when faced with adversaries, while Ecclesiastes warns against giving undue attention to hurtful words. Ultimately, Jesus pronounces a blessing on those who are not offended in Him, highlighting the spiritual strength found in steadfast trust.
